name: Lancement
title: 🚀 Shroud War IS LIVE
body:
**The frontier is open. Drop in.**

Loot, fight, extract — or lose everything trying.

**⚔️ Three ways to fight**
🎒 **EXFIL** — loot, survive, reach extraction. High risk, high reward.
🥇 **DUALS** — ranked. ARENA elimination + BLITZ 5v5 attack/defend.
💥 **DEATHMATCH** — pure PvP, nothing to lose.

**🔫 50+ real weapons** with a full gunsmith — optics, lasers, grips, magazines, tracer rounds. Every part changes how the gun handles.

**▶️ PLAY NOW:** {GAME_URL}

**🎁 Launch week rewards** — see the pinned event post.
Pick your side in <#choose-your-faction> and find a squad in <#looking-for-group>.

*Rusfor or Rainor. The frontier takes no neutrals.*
footer: Thanks for being here from day one. — The Shroud War team

⚡ **Double XP** on every mode
💰 **+50% gold** on successful EXFIL extractions
🏆 **Faction War** — every EXFIL match scores for your faction. The winning side gets an exclusive role and an in-game reward.

📊 Live standings in <#leaderboard-and-scores>
🎬 Post your best moments in <#clips-and-screenshots> — the top 3 clips win a custom role.
